analyst_view.overall: Bottom side Venezia (6 points from 12) host in-form Bologna (9th, unbeaten in five, two points off the European places) at the Penzo on Friday. Davide Nicola's Venezia lost 4-0 at Juventus and have scored only 3 in six; Mazzocchi and Correia (hamstring strains) and Basic (fatigue) are expected to miss out again, Franjic and Sverko are long-term absentees, and Adorante is still not back, with the numbers already counting the main ones. Raffaele Palladino's Bologna had Happonen, Miranda, El Azzouzi and Enem training apart on 24 November and Holm is out long-term; Miranda looks unlikely, but these players have been missing recently, so Bologna's strong form already reflects it. No referee is named yet, and nothing points away from the numbers, so I stay with them.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals, 1.6 for Bologna. Venezia barely score (3 in six) and Bologna have 12 in six, which the numbers already count, along with Basic and Mazzocchi missing for Venezia; Bologna's absentees have been out for their winning run too. I stay at about 2.4.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.9 corners, 4.8 for Bologna. Bologna's wide play has won 39 corners in six and Venezia have conceded 40, which the numbers already add; Venezia lose width on the right without Mazzocchi and Correia and Bologna likely miss winger Miranda, which roughly cancel out. I stay at about 8.9.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.6 cards. Venezia have been booked only 5 times in six games and the numbers already take about 8% off for it; a relegation-threatened home side could get edgier, but no referee is named yet, so I stay at about 3.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.2 shots, 14.2 for Bologna. Bologna's 91 shots in six are already counted, and Venezia under Nicola still get shots off (75 in six) even when losing. I stay at about 25.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.3 shots on target, 4.8 for Bologna. Bologna's sharp finishing lately (33 on target in six) is already added and Venezia's low accuracy too; Adorante is still not back to lift Venezia's attack, so I stay at about 8.3.
